title: Commutative topological algebras on translation-invariant reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces
summary: We study commutative topological algebras naturally associated with translation-invariant reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces whose direct integral decomposition has one-dimensional fibers. Starting from the bounded algebra of translation-invariant operators, we pass to a common dense domain generated by reproducing kernels and identify the corresponding diagonalizable operators with multiplication by symbols in an intersection of weighted $L^2$-spaces.
